source.title: Manufacturer alias review: 40 proposals from the B2 full run
source.body:
Review the 40 manufacturer aliases proposed by the B2 full run (PR #72).

## Evidence

Full record, with what each row rests on: [`alias_reviews/2026-11-06-b2-full-aliases.md`](https://github.com/conol-ai/cohdl/blob/100b7a9/tools/sourcing_data/alias_reviews/2026-11-06-b2-full-aliases.md). Proposals: [`alias_proposals.json`](https://github.com/conol-ai/cohdl/blob/100b7a9/tools/sourcing_data/lcsc_backfill/2026-11-06-full/alias_proposals.json); the identities behind them are the `manufacturer_not_matched` rows of [`review.json`](https://github.com/conol-ai/cohdl/blob/100b7a9/tools/sourcing_data/lcsc_backfill/2026-11-06-full/review.json).

## What an alias does

`tools/sourcing_data/mfr_aliases.json` lets a supplier's manufacturer name stand for the library's. It is applied by `lcsc_backfill.py` and `promote_lcsc_map.py`, uploaded to the registry's `manufacturer_aliases` table with the LCSC catalog (plan D2), and used by `cohdl suppliers`. It applies to every part number whose page shows that supplier name, not only the rows below. It joins names; it never joins different MPNs. Each supplier name maps to exactly one library name.

A wrong alias would let a binding to another company's part pass the audit, so each needs a decision.

## Counts

**Identities** are library (mfr, mpn) pairs; **candidate pages** are catalog part numbers, and one MPN can have several. The 40 proposals cover 184 identities and 211 candidate pages (the `identities` field of `alias_proposals.json` counts pages). Three identities appear in two rows: `RT9080-33GJ5` (7, 33), `NS4168` (34, 39), `CYPD6227-96BZXI` (19, 20). **Map if accepted** applies that one alias to the archived pages with the current selection rule; a tie stays in review. With 1–32, 37 and 39 accepted and the rest rejected, 174 of the 184 map, 5 stay tied and 5 unmatched.

## Needing attention (33–40)

| # | Supplier name (page) | Library name | Identities | Candidate pages | Map if accepted | Library packages | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 33 | `TECH PUBLIC` | `Richtek` | 1 | 1 | 1 | `@contrib/ldo` | C20617299 `RT9080-33GJ5` |
| 34 | `Yongfukang` | `NSIWAY` | 1 | 1 | 1 | `audio-amp` | C5246378 `NS4168` |
| 35 | `Johanson Dielectrics` | `Johanson Technology` | 1 | 1 | 1 | `antenna` | C2917717 `2450AT18B100E` |
| 36 | `Analog Devices` | `Analog Devices/Maxim Integrated` | 1 | 1 | 1 | `switches` | C79401 `MAX16054AZT+T` |
| 37 | `HRS(Hirose)` | `HRS` | 2 | 2 | 2 | `connectors` | C506791 `FH12-10S-0.5SH(55)`, C202112 `FH12-24S-0.5SH(55)` |
| 38 | `HRS(Hirose)` | `Hirose Electric` | 2 | 2 | 2 | `connectors` | C202113 `FH12-26S-0.5SH(55)`, C88373 `U.FL-R-SMT-1(10)` |
| 39 | `Shenzhen Nsiway Tech` | `NSIWAY` | 1 | 1 | 1 | `audio-amp` | C910588 `NS4168` |
| 40 | `Shenzhen Nsiway Tech` | `Nsiway` | 1 | 1 | 1 | `@contrib/audio-amp` | C189961 `NS4150B` |

- **33 `TECH PUBLIC` → `Richtek`:** not the same company; TECH PUBLIC sells its own parts under other makers' part names. Recommended: reject.
- **34 `Yongfukang` → `NSIWAY`:** not the same company. Recommended: reject.
- **35 `Johanson Dielectrics` → `Johanson Technology`:** two companies (capacitors vs RF components). Recommended: reject.
- **36 `Analog Devices` → `Analog Devices/Maxim Integrated`:** the library name is a combined form on one part; the alias would join every Analog Devices page to it. Recommended: reject, and settle the library's name instead.
- **37/38 `HRS(Hirose)`, 39/40 `Shenzhen Nsiway Tech`:** the library spells each company two ways, and one supplier name can stand for only one library name. Recommended: pick one spelling per company and accept that row; the other waits until the library uses one name.

## Decision

Please comment with accept or reject per row, e.g. "accept 1–32, 37, 39; reject 33–36, 38, 40". That comment is the review. Accepted aliases are then added to `mfr_aliases.json` in a PR; the run is repeated offline with the new table (this archive records the old table's hash), and only then are the new rows promoted. Rejected ones stay out.

comments.author: conol-tony
comments.text:
accept 1–32, 38, 39; reject 33–37, 40

- **33–35:** not the same company. TECH PUBLIC sells its own parts under other makers' part numbers. Yongfukang is not NSIWAY. Johanson Dielectrics (capacitors) and Johanson Technology (RF) are separate companies.
- **36:** rejected; fix the library instead. `@contrib/audio-amp` already writes plain `Analog Devices`, so the next `switches` version should write `Analog Devices` for `MAX16054AZT+T`, which then matches with no alias.
- **37/38:** `Hirose Electric` is the canonical spelling. The next `connectors` version should rename its two `HRS` entries, after which their identities map through 38.
- **39/40:** the official `audio-amp` package's `NSIWAY` is the canonical spelling. `@contrib/audio-amp` should move from `Nsiway` to it.
- **19/20:** both accepted; the selection rule settles `CYPD6227-96BZXI` on C22453211.
